NGA.note: Only says the ecosystem aims to improve authentication; no service is stated.
Names NIMC and NPopC (births and deaths) as partners for foundational ID; no record flow between the registers is stated.
Pension payments are named only as a use of citizenship data; no digital payment is stated.
No count or share enrolled is given.
No number at birth is stated.
NIMC is called custodian of the database; who operates, maintains or owns the platform is not stated.
Lists agencies' own registries but does not say any is keyed on the NIN.

facts.fact: NIMC's page says NIMC enrolment centres nationwide continue to provide enrolment and NIN issuance, and that NIMC is custodian of the central National Identity Database.

NGA.note: Describes agencies and private firms that may rely on ID, but no service is stated to verify against the NIN.
Local governments are named only as ID users; no office connection is stated.
Police Force named only as operating a registry of people in conflict with the law; no station records stated.
NPopC is named as the body registering births and deaths; no digital entry at offices is stated.
